name: Permutation Group Orbit Isomorphism
description: Replaces linear algebra span over difference vectors with permutation group orbits generated by transpositions. Since transpositions (i, j) act exactly like edges {i, j} in a graph, and orbits act like connected components, the requirement that a subset of elements shares an orbit is mathematically identical to a minimum-weight Steiner tree problem on the corresponding graph. This avoids graph/tree vocabulary entirely while preserving the exact algorithmic structure.
